admission.justification: The new negative witness guards the refusal, and an import placed above the version test would replace the actionable named refusal with an import error on exactly the interpreters the check exists to refuse.

applicability: Every invocation of scripts/check-python-runtime.py and .githooks/_gate.sh across host bootstrap, Git hooks, CI workflows, and Dagger candidate proofs.
conditions: The checker requires --expected-version to be a major.minor version (3.14), accepts any patch of that minor, and refuses any other minor with expected minor, observed version, and executable before importing 3.14-only stdlib modules.

The checker and hook inspect the unresolved pyvenv.cfg home (or base interpreter path) through python_runtime.is_uv_minor_base without executing uv, refusing exact patch directories and bases outside uv_python_directory().

Built-in modules such as readline report 'built-in' without crashing, Linux --require-linux-pidfd enforces callable os.pidfd_open and signal.pidfd_send_signal, and provenance records observed uvVersion, pythonBuild, and optional uvImageDigest.
exclusions: The checker does not select or install an interpreter; it validates and refuses.
Observed patch builds are recorded as provenance and are not compared across environments.

evidence: The real matrix accepts 3.14.8 and refuses 3.14.4, 3.13.15, 3.12.3 and 3.11.13 with the exact named expected/observed/executable refusal; the portable negative witness fails on captured 84f48 and passes on the frozen tree.

statement: The hook and runtime checker verify the configured minor and the unresolved uv base without invoking uv, keep the Linux pidfd check, and record observed uv version and optional image digest provenance.
title: Hook and checker verify Python 3.14 minor and uv minor link without uv
